# shopify_product (List Resource)

Lists all products of the store, gift card products included. Generated config carries every core attribute and one block per variant, so a large catalogue produces a long file. A product with a linked option is listed with `options` and `variants` left out, so they stay unmanaged.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Large catalogues produce long generated config; limit the list when bootstrapping.
list "shopify_product" "all" {
  provider = shopify
  limit    = 50
}
```
